# TFR UK rework v2 - part core: the four variable-driven national spirits of ENG.
# Every line reads a variable set in history/countries/ENG - Britain.txt and changed by focuses
# with add_to_variable (tooltip key <variable>_tt). Each spirit has renamed copies that are wired
# identically; the ENG_rename_* effects swap them so exactly one copy is ever active.
# The values are capped by ENG_clamp_spirit_variables (TFR_ENG_core_effects.txt).
# Generated by SCRATCH/build2/core_work/gen_core.py - edit the table there, not the copies here.

### ECONOMY

ENG_economy_dyn = { # Recovering from the Depression
	enable = { always = yes }
	icon = GFX_idea_great_depression

	consumer_goods_factor                      = var:ENG_eco_consumer_goods
	industrial_capacity_factory                = var:ENG_eco_factory_output_total
	industrial_capacity_dockyard               = var:ENG_eco_dockyard_output
	production_speed_industrial_complex_factor = var:ENG_eco_civ_construction
	production_speed_arms_factory_factor       = var:ENG_eco_mil_construction
	production_speed_dockyard_factor           = var:ENG_eco_dock_construction
	production_speed_infrastructure_factor     = var:ENG_eco_infra_construction
	production_factory_max_efficiency_factor   = var:ENG_eco_efficiency_cap
	production_factory_efficiency_gain_factor  = var:ENG_eco_efficiency_gain
	production_factory_start_efficiency_factor = var:ENG_eco_start_efficiency
	line_change_production_efficiency_factor   = var:ENG_eco_line_retention
	research_speed_factor                      = var:ENG_eco_research
	conversion_cost_civ_to_mil_factor          = var:ENG_eco_conversion
	local_resources_factor                     = var:ENG_eco_resources
	global_building_slots_factor               = var:ENG_eco_slots
}

### ARMY

ENG_army_dyn = { # Legacy of the Ten Year Rule
	enable = { always = yes }
	icon = GFX_idea_generic_army_war_college

	army_attack_factor           = var:ENG_army_attack
	army_defence_factor          = var:ENG_army_defence
	army_org_factor              = var:ENG_army_org
	army_speed_factor            = var:ENG_army_speed
	planning_speed               = var:ENG_army_planning
	max_planning_factor          = var:ENG_army_max_planning
	land_doctrine_cost_factor    = var:ENG_army_doctrine_cost
	training_time_army_factor    = var:ENG_army_training_time
	supply_consumption_factor    = var:ENG_army_supply
	army_armor_attack_factor     = var:ENG_army_armor_attack
	army_armor_defence_factor    = var:ENG_army_armor_defence
	army_armor_speed_factor      = var:ENG_army_armor_speed
	army_infantry_attack_factor  = var:ENG_army_infantry_attack
	army_infantry_defence_factor = var:ENG_army_infantry_defence
	army_artillery_attack_factor = var:ENG_army_artillery_attack
	special_forces_cap           = var:ENG_army_special_forces_cap
	special_forces_attack_factor = var:ENG_army_special_forces_attack
	breakthrough_factor          = var:ENG_army_breakthrough
	recon_factor                 = var:ENG_army_recon
	max_dig_in_factor            = var:ENG_army_entrenchment
	land_reinforce_rate          = var:ENG_army_reinforce
	invasion_preparation         = var:ENG_army_invasion_prep
	experience_gain_army_factor  = var:ENG_army_xp_gain
}

### NAVY
